# [reference] Ground clearance measurements by vehicle area

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Measurements assume tires of similar size to the stock 32s. [t829]

## Specifications

- **Center-rear skidplate section (Frontier)**: 12 inch [t829] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Drop bracket center clearance (Xterra)**: 13 inch [t829] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Frame below doors (exposed, Xterra)**: 16 inch [t829] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Frame below doors with sliders (Frontier)**: 14.5 inch [t829] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Rear crossmember clearance (Xterra)**: 13 inch [t829] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Skidplate under factory crossmember (Frontier)**: 11 inch [t829] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Transfer case height (Xterra)**: 12 inch [t829] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Measurements assume tires of similar size to the stock 32s. [t829]
